+"""Vision-guided controller for the one ALOHA peg insertion episode.
+
+The only state read from the service is camera imagery/calibration and robot
+proprioception.  Intermediate calibration and observations are recorded here.
+"""
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+CAMERAS = ('overhead_cam', 'teleoperator_pov', 'wrist_cam_left', 'wrist_cam_right')
+
+
+def record(name, res):
+    folder = OUT / name
+    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+    (folder / 'meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2))
+    for cam, rgb in res.last.items():
+        np.save(folder / f'{cam}_rgb.npy', rgb)
+        Image.fromarray(rgb).save(folder / f'{cam}.png')
+    for cam, depth in res.depth.items():
+        np.save(folder / f'{cam}_depth.npy', depth)
+    if res.proprio is not None:
+        np.save(folder / 'proprio.npy', res.proprio)
+    return res
+
+
+def q_now(res):
+    return np.array(res.meta['proprio']['now'][:14], dtype=float)
+
+
+def cams_T(res):
+    return {k: np.array(v['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
+            for k,v in res.meta['cameras'].items()}
+
+
+def observe(r, name, depth=True):
+    return record(name, r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=depth, video='none'))
+
+
+def move(r, q, sec, name, depth=True):
+    res = r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(q)[None,:], dt=sec,
+                   cameras=CAMERAS, video='none', include_depth=depth,
+                   note=name)
+    print(name, 'time_left', res.meta['time_left_s'],
+          'q', np.round(q_now(res), 3), flush=True)
+    return record(name, res)
+
+
+def calibrate(r):
+    h = observe(r, 'cal_home', depth=False)
+    q0 = q_now(h)
+    q0[[6,13]] = .037
+    h = move(r, q0, 1., 'cal_open', depth=False)
+    q0 = q_now(h)
+    records = {'home_q':q0.tolist(), 'home_T':{k:v.tolist() for k,v in cams_T(h).items()}}
+    for j in range(6):
+        q = q0.copy()
+        q[[j,j+7]] += .12
+        p = move(r, q, 1., f'cal_plus_{j}', depth=False)
+        records[f'plus_{j}'] = {'q':q_now(p).tolist(), 'T':{k:v.tolist() for k,v in cams_T(p).items()}}
+        h = move(r, q0, 1., f'cal_back_{j}', depth=False)
+        records[f'back_{j}'] = {'q':q_now(h).tolist(), 'T':{k:v.tolist() for k,v in cams_T(h).items()}}
+    (OUT/'calibration.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
+    observe(r,'post_cal',depth=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    r = Robot()
+    if len(sys.argv)>1 and sys.argv[1]=='calibrate':
+        calibrate(r)
